data.title: Vue
data.tagline: A JavaScript framework for building interactive interfaces with templates and components
data.learningOutcome: You can see how a Vue ref and template binding keep button text in sync with a value.
data.description: When a `+1` button changes a count from 0 to 1, Vue updates the bound text on the page. It controls how the interface reflects data; a server still handles durable storage.

learning.assumes: You know a number on a page can change.
learning.outcome: You can see how a Vue ref and template binding keep button text in sync with a value.

explanation.title: A ref holds the value
explanation.text: A ref can remember whether `count` is 0 or 1.

explanation.title: The template reads it
explanation.text: `{{ count }}` means show the current value of `count` here.

explanation.title: A change updates the view
explanation.text: When a click changes the ref, Vue updates the template locations that read it.

data.boundary: Templates follow reactive data. Changing an ordinary variable may not update the interface; first check whether Vue manages that data.

lessonPractice.title: A theme name appears in a settings input and preview heading, and the preview should change while typing. What should Vue own?

options.label: Bind input and preview to one reactive state so the view updates when it changes
options.feedback: Vue renders related components from state, avoiding manual lookup and synchronization of text nodes.

options.label: After each keypress, find the preview DOM and replace its text directly
options.feedback: Manual operations bypass the reactive source and easily miss new preview locations.

options.label: Assume using Vue automatically saves the theme name to the server
options.feedback: Vue updates the current interface; it does not automatically provide requests, databases, or persistence.

data.agentPrompt: Bind the theme-name input and preview heading to one Vue reactive state for immediate updates without direct DOM manipulation. Let Save call the existing API, then test unsaved and saved states across refresh.
